PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  CITY OF AVALON
  Wednesday, April 20, 2022 at 5:00 p.m.
  410 Avalon Canyon Road, Avalon

 In compliance with the Americans with Disability Act, if you need special assistance to participate in
 this meeting, please contact Denise Radde, City Clerk (310) 510-0220. Notification 48 hours prior to
 the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this
 meeting. (28 CFR 35. 102-35.104 ADA Title II). All public records relating to an agenda item on this
 agenda are available for the public inspection at the time the records are distributed to all, or a majority
 of all, members of the Planning Commission. Such records shall be available at City Hall located at
 410 Avalon Canyon Road.

Due to health recommendations from the Center for Disease Control and State of California
Division of Occupational Safety and Health (Cal/OSHA), and the declared state of emergency
wherein social distancing measures have been imposed or recommended, the CITY OF
AVALON'S CITY COUNCIL and PLANNING COMMISSION MEETINGS SHALL
GENERALLY BE AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC REMOTELY. The general public may
attend the meeting in the Council Chambers however must adhere to social distancing
requirements and wear a mask or face covering at all times. The public is encouraged to watch
and participate from the safety of their homes while practicing social distancing.

Council Chambers are open to a maximum 30 members of the general public. Once the Council
Chambers reach maximum occupancy, the general public may participate in Oral
Communication and address the Planning Commission on an agenda item in-person by waiting
in the City Hall Court Yard and entering the Chambers one at a time at the appropriate time. No
one will be admitted into the Council Chambers who is ill or exhibiting symptoms of COVID-19.
All individuals entering the Council Chambers must wear a mask or face covering at all times.
Additionally, the general public may participate in Oral Communication and address the
Planning Commission on an agenda item by providing comments via e-Comment.

  The meeting can be viewed:
  On local cable: Catalina Broadband Solutions channel 3
  Streaming Online: www.cityofavalon.com/meetings
  *Streaming on Facebook Live: www.facebook.com/CityOfAvalonOfficial
  To submit comments using eComment, please follow this link:
  https://avalon.granicusideas.com
  Click the Meetings tab and then Post to comment on the 04/20/2022 meeting

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE/ROLL CALL

CONSENT CALENDAR

  1. MINUTES
   Although the live recording is the official record of public meetings, actions are prepared
  for the Planning Commission’s approval.

  Recommended Action
  Approve the actions from the March 16, 2022 regular Planning Commission Meeting.

  Approve the actions from the March 21, 2022 Special Planning Commission Meeting.

2. Findings to Continue to Hold Remote Teleconference/Virtual Planning Commission
  Meeitings Pursuant to Assembly Bill 361
  At the October 22, 2021 City of Avalon Planning Commission (“Planning Commision”)
  meeting, the Planning Commission for the first time made findings pursuant to Assembly
  Bill 361 to continue to meet remotely. The Planning Commission most recently renewed
  such findings at its February 16, 2022 Planning Commission meeting. To continue this
  practice, it is required, that the Planning Commission determine that the COVID-19 state
  of emergency proclaimed by the Governor still exists and has been considered by the
  Planning Commission in deciding to continue to have teleconference meetings and that
  state or local officials have imposed or recommended measures to promote social
  distancing in connection with COVID-19, and that as a result of the COVID-19
  emergency, meeting in person would present imminent risks to the health or safety of
  attendees. Because these findings must be made every thirty (30) days, the Planning
  Commission will have to make these findings at its upcoming April 20, 2022 meeting and
  thirty (30) days thereafter.

  Recommended Action
  Determine that the COVID-19 state of emergency proclaimed by the Governor still exists
  and has been considered by the Planning Commission in deciding to continue to have
  teleconference meetings and that state or local officials have imposed or recommended
  measures to promote social distancing in connection with COVID-19, and that as a result
  of the COVID-19 emergency, meeting in person would present imminent risks to the
  health or safety of attendees.

GENERAL BUSINESS:

1. Request for approval of a Site Plan (Section 9-8.201 et seq. of the Avalon Municipal
  Code (“AMC”)) for the remodel of an existing multi-family dwelling, categorically
  exempt from environmental review under Section 15301 of the State CEQA Guidelines
  – Existing Facilities. The Planning Commission will consider staff’s
  recommendation the project is in the Coastal Zone and is exempt from a Coastal
  Development Permit according to Municipal Code section 9-8.102(b)(2).

  Owner/Applicant:  Monica & Tim Canby
  Filing Date:  02/01/2022
  Location of Project:  208 Whittley Avenue
  APN:  7480-027-006
   PC #:  2788
  Zone:  High Density Residential

PUBLIC HEARING:

1. A Public Hearing and consideration of a Setback Variance for an ongoing remodel of a
  duplex in the Medium Density Residential zone, in order to correct an error in the
  entitlements that were deemed necessary at the time. No other changes are proposed to
  the plans included in PC Staff Report #2711 approved November 20th 2019, with the
  exception of the setback variance. The Planning Commission issued a Coastal
  Development Permit on 8/27/19, which will not be affected by the issuance of this
  Variance. The project is Categorically Exempt under Section 15301 of the State CEQA
  Guidelines – Existing Facilities.

  Owner/Applicant: Scott Vanevery
  Filing Date:  02/08/2022
  Location of Project: 261 E. Whittley.
  APN:  7480-027-020
  PC #:  2783
  Zone:  Medium Density Residential

2. A Public Hearing and consideration of a Resolution for an application for Conditional
  Use Permit, Site Plan, and Coastal Development Permit to convert a clothing store into an
  ice cream shop. The project is in the Coastal Zone and is subject to a Coastal
  Development Permit, which requires a public hearing and Planning Commission
  approval. The Planning Commission will determine whether the project is within the 300-
  foot appealable seaward area boundary. The project is Categorically Exempt under
  Section 15305 of the State CEQA Guidelines – Minor Alteration in Land Use
  Limitations.

  Owner:  George Adams
  Applicant:  Cameron Crockett
  Filing Date:  02/25/2022
  Location of Project: 103 Pebbly Beach Road
  APN:  7480-005-019
  PC #:  2789
  Zone:  Commercial Zone

3. A Public Hearing and consideration of a Resolution for an application for a Transient
  Rental License and a Coastal Development Permit to allow the renting or leasing of a
  room or rooms with or without table boards for periods of fewer than thirty (30)
  consecutive days duration (Transient Rental – Section 9-6.602 (a) of the Avalon
  Municipal Code) in unit 82 Playa Azul, located in building eight (8) of the Hamilton
  Cove Condominiums and approving a resolution. The project is in the Coastal Zone and
  is subject to a Coastal Development Permit, which requires a public hearing and
  Planning Commission approval. The Planning Commission will determine whether the
   project is within the 300-foot appealable seaward area boundary. The project is
  Categorically Exempt under Section 15305 of the State CEQA Guidelines – Minor
  Alterations in Land Use Limitations.

  Owner/Applicant: Mark and Carol Forbush
  Filing Date:  04/01/2022
  Location of Project: Unit 82 Playa Azul, in building 8 of the Hamilton Cove Condos
  APN:  7480-048-033
  PC #:  2790
  Zone:  Low-Density Residential

  4. A Public Hearing and consideration of a Resolution for a Zoning Ordinance Amendment
  and General Plan Amendment for a City owned residential property located at 206 East
  Whittley. This application includes changes to the Zoning Map and General Plan Land
  Use Designation from Commercial to Multiple Residential, High Density. The project is
  in the Coastal Zone and is subject to a Coastal Development Permit, which requires a
  public hearing and Planning Commission approval. The Planning Commission will
  determine whether the project is within the 300-foot appealable seaward area boundary.
  The project is Categorically Exempt pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA) Guidelines Section 15332 & 15183.

  Owner/Applicant: City of Avalon
  Filing Date:  04/01/2022
  Location of Project: 206 E Whittley
  APN:  7480-018-909
  PC #:  2791
  Zone:  Commercial (C)

ITEMS OF DISCUSSION:

PLANNING DIRECTOR / CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS

COMMISSIONER BUSINESS

BUSINESS FROM THE AUDIENCE

ADJOURN

Anyone may appeal any decision made by the Commission to the City Council. To appeal, you
must file a written appeal, and include an appeal fee of $1027.00 with the City Clerk within
fifteen (15) calendar days of such action. Any person challenging actions of the Planning
Commission may be limited to issues he or someone else raises in writing prior to or orally at the
hearing. Any person may appeal the Planning Commission’s determination that a proposed
project is seaward of the appealable seaward area boundary to the Coastal Commission, and
 following exhaustion of local appeals, any aggrieved person may appeal actions on local Coastal
Development Permits seaward of the appealable area boundary to the Coastal Commission.

By: Rocio De La Cruz  Posted: City Hall  Friday, April 15, 2022
